stage.name: Narrow Path
stage.description:
The narrow path that good and evil share doesn't always mean rare cooperation. Sometimes, it's the narrow way out that they must both fight for equally.
Choose a foe and fight. Losing will not deduct Life Points. Defeating a tougher foe within the given time grants better reward
stage.source: mode level file; no stage_table row

tiacauh_fanatic.name: Tiacauh Fanatic
tiacauh_fanatic.flavourText: A fervent Tiacauh warrior with very fast attack speed. Though each strike is not particularly powerful, those caught off guard will be quickly subdued by a rain of blows.
abilities: Every attack reduces the enemy's DEF

lurker.name: Lurker
lurker.flavourText: One of Reunion's special soldiers. They move swiftly and stealthily, making it almost impossible to detect them before they engage in combat. Therefore, teamwork is needed in order to defeat them.
abilities: Invisible

guerrilla_herald.name: Guerrilla Herald
guerrilla_herald.flavourText: Patriot's guerilla fighters employ a special language to communicate and synergize their coordinated operations on the battlefield. The heralds are important links within their communication system. While present, they will issue tactical commands to increase the offensive and defensive abilities of nearby allies.
abilities: Increases the ATK and DEF of enemy units when on the battlefield.

lakeside_volunteer.name: Lakeside Volunteer
lakeside_volunteer.flavourText: An amateur lifeguard doing nothing in particular. Because there really was nobody in need of saving, he instead decided to take up boxing, and unexpectedly had quite the talent for it.
abilities: Upon dropping below half HP for the first time, gains 100% Physical Dodge for a period of time

mortar_gunner.name: Mortar Gunner
mortar_gunner.flavourText: One of Reunion's special ranged soldiers. Equipped with pilfered military-grade Originium launchers, they launch explosive attacks from hard-to-defend positions, making them a significant threat to back-line Operators.
abilities: Capable of extremely long ranged-attacks
Shells deal area damage to target and any allied units in the surrounding 8 tiles

sniper_leader.name: Sniper Leader
sniper_leader.flavourText: A basic ranged soldier. They are stronger than normal Snipers, firing improved ammunition that stuns for a longer duration. Proceed with caution.
abilities: After two attacks, the next attack Stuns its target

tidal_caster.name: Tidal Caster
tidal_caster.flavourText: Professionally trained casters whose duties involve simulating the tides of Dossoles's sea. Adept at using Originium Arts that mimic the erosive effect of the tides.
abilities: Attacks deal damage to the target and all allied units in the target's four adjacent tiles, additionally inflicting Corrosion

tidal_leader.name: Tidal Leader
tidal_leader.flavourText: The elites among the Tidal Casters. They are in charge of leading and supervising the Tidal Casters. Extremely adept at using Originium Arts that mimic the erosive effect of the tides.
abilities: Attacks deal damage to the target and all allied units in the target's four adjacent tiles, additionally inflicting Corrosion

ursus_civilian.name: Ursus Civilian
ursus_civilian.flavourText: An ordinary Ursus citizen caught in the crossfire. A part of the cruelty and suffering of this world.
abilities: Does not deplete Life Points when spared, but will deplete a Life Point upon dying
Does not count towards the defeated enemies counter

wraith.name: Wraith
wraith.flavourText: One of Reunion's engineers. Though unarmed, they utilize their agility and cunning to slip through defenses in order to sabotage mechanical and electrical equipment.
abilities: Cannot be blocked.

invisible_caster.name: Invisible Caster
invisible_caster.flavourText: One of Reunion's Casters. The ghillie suit they wear makes it almost impossible to detect them before they engage in combat. Therefore, teamwork is needed to defeat them.
abilities: Invisible

bully.name: Bully
bully.flavourText: Special melee combatants. Their unstoppable bulk is equivalent to blocking three normal enemies, and Operators who cannot block three enemies may not be able to halt their advance at all.
abilities: Can only be blocked by Operators with 3 or more Block

duck_lord.name: Duck Lord
duck_lord.flavourText: A famous Columbian investor, entrepreneur, and master of 'Duck Power.' Out of the public eye, enjoys kicking back with others...
abilities: Cannot be blocked.
Gains significantly increased Movement Speed after being attacked

gopnik.name: Gopnik
gopnik.flavourText: The Ursus security guard hired by Duck Lord. Powerful, but not very smart. Mainly responsible for carrying luggage for Duck Lord.

r_31_heavy_power_armor.name: R-31 Heavy Power Armor
r_31_heavy_power_armor.flavourText: A model that appeared around half a year ago among some mercenary groups, its performance is on par with mass-produced military models from five years ago. Rhine Lab's Energy Section cooperates with many parties, and continues to look for ever more opportunities.
abilities: [Overload] Continuously deals Physical damage to the target proportional to the unit's ATK, andStuns the target

sarkaz_wither_devourer.name: Sarkaz Wither Devourer
sarkaz_wither_devourer.flavourText: Part of the Nachzehrer army. Devours any obstacle in its way, including the living. Anything and everything is food to it.
abilities: When blocked for the first time, devours the blocker. DEF is greatly increased, but Movement Speed is reduced
Returns devoured Operator when defeated

agent_leader.name: Agent Leader
agent_leader.flavourText: A caster who utilizes coordinated tactics. They are stronger than normal Agents. They are able to enhance their melee attacks with Arts damage, and employ a variety of techniques to break through unprepared defenders.
abilities: Attacks temporarily reduce allied units' Block

dockworker.name: Dockworker
dockworker.flavourText: Brawny brutes who work at the docks or on Pancho's ships. They enjoy playing cards and drinking, and usually spend the day in a drunken haze. Because they regularly work around seawater, they're more subjected to Erosion.
abilities: Stuns allied units after several attacks
Quickly loses HP while under the effects of 'Erosion'

dockworker_leader.name: Dockworker Leader
dockworker_leader.flavourText: Giant brutes who work at the docks or on Pancho's ships. They enjoy playing cards and drinking, and usually spend the day in a drunken haze. They're much more robust than regular dockworkers, but they are still quite subjected to Erosion.
abilities: Stuns allied units after several attacks
Quickly loses HP while under the effects of 'Erosion'

dockworker_leader_motorboat.name: Dockworker Leader Motorboat
dockworker_leader_motorboat.flavourText: A Dockworker Leader on a motorboat. The Dockworker Leader will continue battle after the vehicle is destroyed.
abilities: Can only be blocked by units with at least 3 Block, and deals Physical damage by colliding with player's units
The <Dockworker Leader> will continue battle after the vehicle is destroyed

elite_imperial_striker.name: Elite Imperial Striker
elite_imperial_striker.flavourText: The powerful, battle-tested infantry of the Ursus Army, the backbone of the Imperial Army's aggressive advance. They are versatile in offense and defense, melee and ranged. After sustain a certain amount of damage, their morale will peak, causing them to inflict more destruction. Along with the Shieldguards, they formed the front line of the Ursus Army.
abilities: Gains significantly increased ATK when HP is under 50%

fatty.name: Fatty
fatty.flavourText: Duck Lord's associate and apprentice, an opportunist with a slick tongue. Frequently appears on dubious TV shows, preaching about how he cares little for losses or gains, as they are part of the natural money-making process.
abilities: Always faces the direction with the most Operators.
Takes 80% less Physical/Arts damage from the front.

hateful_avenger_enemy_1025_reveng_2.name: Hateful Avenger
hateful_avenger_enemy_1025_reveng_2.flavourText: An unidentified combatant who attacks using unconventional methods, more dangerous than a normal Avenger. Equipped with a special weapon, they are known to change their attack patterns during combat, making them difficult to defend against. Proceed with caution.
abilities: Gains significantly increased ATK when HP is under 50%

heavy_defender_leader.name: Heavy Defender Leader
heavy_defender_leader.flavourText: One of Reunion's melee soldiers, more dangerous than a normal Heavy Defender. Equipped with a full set of heavy armor, they have ample combat experience and are extremely hard to defeat. As they may have had formal training, proceed with caution.

lazurite_monique.name: Lazurite, Monique
lazurite_monique.flavourText: A Lazurite of the Armorless Union, Monique. She has a habit of recording her own condition in great detail before operations. She hates Roy and anyone who interrupts her work.
abilities: Every attack deals Corrosion
After several attacks, the next attack deals more damage

lazurite_roy.name: Lazurite, Roy
lazurite_roy.flavourText: A Lazurite of the Armorless Union, Roy. No one knows how a killer managed to achieve such a position and hold it for so many years. Rumor says that his wealth has already surpassed the CEOs of some small companies, while his power exceeds many competition knights.
abilities: Every attack deals Corrosion
After several attacks, the next attack deals more damage

lost_contraption.name: Lost Contraption
lost_contraption.flavourText: An automated thought collector built by a lost Kazdelian empire. It has continuously operated for so long that its movements have become slow and haphazard.
abilities: Steals Originium Ingots upon entering the Objective.

lost_hovercraft.name: Lost Hovercraft
lost_hovercraft.flavourText: An automated thought collector built by a lost Kazdelian empire. Despite its ability to hover for extended periods, its built-in package protection mechanism compels it to land immediately upon encountering interference.
abilities: Low-Altitude Hovering
Steals Originium Ingots upon entering the Objective.

r_11_assault_power_armor.name: R-11 Assault Power Armor
r_11_assault_power_armor.flavourText: A model equipped with long-ranged weapons, massively increasing its offensive capabilities. While these experimental weapons are still in the prototype phase, its energy and firepower cannot be overlooked.
abilities: Attacks 4 enemies simultaneously

sarkaz_crossbowman.name: Sarkaz Crossbowman
sarkaz_crossbowman.flavourText: A mercenary from Sarkaz. Their towering physique has not hampered their marksmanship. On the contrary, it allows them to use larger ranged weapons with ease and withstand more damage.

sarkaz_greatswordsman.name: Sarkaz Greatswordsman
sarkaz_greatswordsman.flavourText: A mercenary from Sarkaz. The Originium inside them has boosted their physical abilities, allowing them to wield larger weapons with ease and withstand more damage.

sarkaz_guerrilla_fighter.name: Sarkaz Guerrilla Fighter
sarkaz_guerrilla_fighter.flavourText: A Sarkaz fighter who supports Patriot but cannot understand the special terminology of their guerilla operations. The Sarkaz ritual maintained by the Sarkaz Originium Altars will not damage them, instead strengthening their bodies and converting their attacks into Arts damage.
abilities: When coming into contact with a Pulse Wave, this unit instead takes no damage and will deal Arts damage with normal attacks.

tiacauh_brave.name: Tiacauh Brave
tiacauh_brave.flavourText: A very formidable Tiacauh warrior, naturally born to do battle. These warriors harbor great pride in their combat abilities, and live for the thrill of the duel no matter where they are. Their single-mindedness allows them to shrug off all outside interference.
abilities: When blocked, this unit will only receive damage from the unit blocking it, and the DEF of both units is decreased.

tidal_leader_speedboat.name: Tidal Leader Speedboat
tidal_leader_speedboat.flavourText: A Tidal Leader on a speedboat. The Tidal Leader will continue battle after the vehicle is destroyed.
abilities: Attacks deal damage to the target and all allied units in the target's four adjacent tiles, additionally inflicting Corrosion
The <Tidal Leader> will continue battle after the vehicle is destroyed

yeti_icecleaver.name: Yeti Icecleaver
yeti_icecleaver.flavourText: A special melee combatant of the Yeti Squadron hailing from teams of infected gerilla warriors in the Northwestern Tundra. Grim reapers on the battlefield, they wield long katanas that can easily ravage frozen Operators, hence the nickname they've been given, 'Ice Cleaver.'
abilities: Attack power increases greatly when attacking Frozen targets

frost_buck.name: 'Frost Buck'
frost_buck.flavourText: An actor playing the role of the Sami Snowpriest's bodyguard, 'Frost Buck'. After countless performances, they have fallen completely into their role, and wish for their demise at the hands of a foe as scary as the 'Demons'.
abilities: Attack power increases greatly when attacking Frozen targets
When <'Snow Doe'> dies, greatly increases ASPD and Movement Speed, and inherits its ability

pompeii.name: 'Pompeii'
pompeii.flavourText: A massive infected beast. These aberrations were born in a special high-temperature environment. Nobody wants to approach these creatures due to their grotesque appearance and the extreme heat they give off. The existence of these giant creatures has been known since ancient times, but to see one warped by infection is terrifyingly unforgettable...
abilities: Can attack up to 4 targets at once and ignites targets it attacks, dealing Immolation damage over time
Self-immolates when blocked, dealing heavy damage
Gains significantly increased ASPD when HP drops to half

snow_doe.name: 'Snow Doe'
snow_doe.flavourText: An actor playing the role of the Sami Snowpriest's bodyguard, 'Snow Doe'. After countless performances, they have fallen completely into their role, and wish for their demise at the hands of a foe as twisted as the 'Frozen Monstrosity'.
abilities: Attacks inflict Cold
When <'Frost Buck'> dies, greatly increases ASPD and Movement Speed, and inherits its ability

crownslayer.name: Crownslayer
crownslayer.flavourText: One of Reunion's squad leaders who handles infiltration and assassination operations, specializing in melee combat and breaking through defensive lines. Her stealth and superb infiltration abilities have foiled countless attempts to capture her.
abilities: When blocked, can quickly move behind the unit

frostnova.name: FrostNova
frostnova.flavourText: A Caster who is one of Reunion's squad leaders. She is one of the few Casters capable of suppressing enemies in a head-on engagement. Among the squads she leads, the special 'Yeti Squadron' assists her in some special operations. As her name implies, she has a cold personality.
abilities: Frequently attacks allied units within range with Ice Nova, dealing heavy Arts damage and reducing the ASPD of affected units for a few seconds
Can Freeze the ground with Arts, rendering them unable to be deployed upon
Revives after dying for the first time, gaining increased ATK

jesselton_williams.name: Jesselton Williams
jesselton_williams.flavourText: Jesselton Williams, a killer who infiltrated the prison disguised as a jailer. Very particular in both speech and action, he remains graceful even in the midst of battle.
abilities: Jailer Form
RES is greatly increased
Attacks become ranged and deal Arts damage, and no longer attacks Imprisonment Devices
Can Stun multiple targets
The first time HP drops to 0, enters Killer Form
Killer Form
Frees all imprisoned enemies when entering Killer Form
Gains significantly increased DEF
Uses melee Physical attacks that ignore a certain amount of the target's DEF

kaltsit.name: Kal'tsit
kaltsit.flavourText: The mediator hesitantly makes a choice that allows no further hesitation: to face the challenge of the Six Heroes. She will fail, and they will succeed.
abilities: Switches position with Mon2tr when HP drops below 50%, dealing Physical damage to all nearby allied units and stunning them for several seconds.

lost_colossus.name: Lost Colossus
lost_colossus.flavourText: An experimental creation of a certain caster from the Spires of Leithanien. This colossus was originally made to be a servant, but the old Spire caster forgot to tell it who to serve…
abilities: Can throw a rock that inflicts a very long Stun (will not target a unit that is already Stunned)

mon2tr.name: Mon2tr
mon2tr.flavourText: The mediator's guardian and companion. It will fail, and they will succeed.
abilities: Upon switching positions or death, deals Physical damage to all nearby allied units and stuns them for several seconds.

skullshatterer.name: Skullshatterer
skullshatterer.flavourText: One of Reunion's squad leaders who serves in the Assault Squad. Though armed with an Originium launcher and explosives, reports show that he possesses high mobility and poses a significant threat even in melee combat.He has been seen several times around Lungmen, and intel suggests that he is carrying out some special operation in the region.
abilities: Launches grenades when not being blocked, significantly reducing the DEF of the target and surrounding allies for a short period of time
Gains significantly increased ATK when HP is under 50%

tidelinked_archon.name: Tidelinked Archon
tidelinked_archon.flavourText: —Sea Terror. Even Ægir technology has a role to play in the evolution of we many.
abilities: Attacks inflict additional Corrosion.
When its Other Half is alive and not in coma, enters a coma when HP reaches 0 and begins regenerating; revives when HP reaches max.

tidelinked_bishop.name: Tidelinked Bishop
tidelinked_bishop.flavourText: A bishop that has partially mutated. It is partly human, partly—
abilities: When its Other Half is alive and not in coma, enters a coma when HP reaches 0 and begins regenerating; revives when HP reaches max.
